config.arm: ARM X: deep supervision on the ARM V recipe (downsample_levels=3 + num_disparities=24, stride 1/8, 8px spacing, range 184px, cost_volume_shift=right, regression_normalize=True); random-init + KITTI only, 200 epochs; total loss = 1.0 * loss_final + 0.5 * loss_aux
config.split_enforcement: train_base split='hailo_calib' only; no hailo_val sample enters optimizer loop
config.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity

supervised_outputs: auxiliary stages[disparity_initial] * feature_stride (soft-argmin candidate units 0..23 -> full-resolution pixels), weight 0.5
deep_supervision.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity, identical call at both heads
deep_supervision.interpolation: none (disparity_initial already full resolution; aux shape asserted equal to target shape)

config.augmentation: random crop, independent per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1; no horizontal flip
config.known_deviation: no batch normalisation (BN-folded exported artifact), carried into all arms
